basic_info.description:
Welcome to your fully furnished, light-filled 1-bedroom sanctuary in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Mission District. Located in a brand-new elevator building, this stylish, 500+ sq ft unit blends comfort, convenience, and city living perfect for professionals, travel nurses, and remote workers.

Brand new secure boutique-style building with elevator and shared roof deck with panoramic views. 

Enjoy this gorgeously furnished 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment on a beautiful street in the Mission District. 

A peaceful sanctuary, yet only steps away from countless dining and nightlife options, including the Valencia corridor and 24th Street (Calle 24). Easy access to downtown SF, the 101/280, and only ~15-20 minutes to SFO. Walking distance to 24th St. BART, SF General Hospital, grocery stores, and much more. Large, secure, city-run parking garage offering hourly and monthly rates is ~2 blocks away.

Building completed in 2025.

15 units in building; secure entrance and smart locks at the unit.

1 bd/1 ba. 503 sq ft.

Bright and airy open floor plan living/kitchen with huge windows. 

Luxury finishes including quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and large black steel frame windows; A/C throughout unit.

Brand-new Electrolux full-size washer and dryer in-unit. 

Building is an HOA managed property; features 24/7 HOA service; elevator to unit; shared roof deck with killer views; shared backyard; bike storage.

Minimum 30-day/month lease.
$4,500K/month | 3-6 month leases preferred and contact me if you're looking for other options. 

Owner pays for water, garbage, and internet, as well as electricity for stays under 60 days.

Minimun 30 day stay
Owner pays for water, garbage, internet and electricity. Tenant pays for electricity beyond 60 days. 
NO smoking
Additional fees for small pets.
